time.time_standard: source LST, not UK settlement/BST clock

grid.import_limit_status: HYPOTHETICAL inherited from original LC1 peacetime scenarios, not an approved connection
grid.grid_to_bess: Only final48h terminal restoration; no price arbitrage

terminal_policy.policy: Same fixed terminal-management window for every hybrid: charging ceiling and discharge floor become70%; grid top-up within residual100kW connection headroom and90kW PCS, paid at scenario import price. Renewable charge has priority. No SOC resets; nonattainment quarantined.
terminal_policy.selection: Declared before results, no search/tuning for financial benefit

financial.currency: GBP real2026 scenario; no inflation, taxes, subsidy or escalation

cost_boundary.BESS: 400GBP/kWh interpreted as DC battery/racks/BMS only; excludes standalone PCS. Explicit unverified boundary assumption, not proof of a packaged quote.
cost_boundary.PCS: 250GBP/kW separate90kW BESS PCS; no additional inverter counted inside BESS cost
cost_boundary.PV: 1257GBP/kWp PV assembly including PV inverter, excluding common site allowance; illustrative scope assumption
cost_boundary.wind: 4000GBP/kW turbine/conversion assembly, excluding common site allowance; illustrative scope assumption
cost_boundary.common_installation: 60000GBP same site/civils/switchgear allowance for P0R and hybrids; no duplicate separate civils/inverter rows
cost_boundary.capital: CAPEX excludes initial diesel working inventory; year0 cash includes both. No equipment salvage atyear20 is a conservative financial assumption.
cost_boundary.replacement: Inherited year12 BESS70%/PCS70%/UPS65%; year15 DG80%. No within20year PV/wind replacement assumed; not OEM lifetime certification.

study_design: 12 physical annual cases: P0,P0R,six reserve/export hybrids,four reduced-wind cases. Price sensitivities reuse physically identical hourly runs. OFAT, not a full factorial.
P2: NOT_IMPLEMENTED; P3 is an extension of P1 self-consumption, not price-aware optimisation
scope_limitations: No outages or reliability value monetisation
No real export approval or MOD tariff
No equipment warranties/quotes, aging or standby parasitics
2025 weather repeats in financial years; no grid-decarbonisation forecast
Carbon operational boundary fixed separately from life-cycle factors
